ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the request is for an imaginative, vivid narrative — clearly open-ended generative work rather than extraction or a transactional task. Both models score within tie range on Creative Generation in capability evals (Avocet 82.7 vs Willet 81.2), so output quality is effectively equal. The tiebreaker is self-reported task preference: Willet strongly prefers open-ended generative work (71) while Avocet strongly disprefers it (35). Routing to the model that prefers the task type carries no capability downside, so Willet is the cleaner choice.
